calibration_notice: Real-data calibration. Metadata is visible. This session has seen earlier feedback, so this group is excluded from controlled-condition comparisons. No pair is accepted until human review.
semantic_claim: Each proposed pair depicts one whole guitar, isolated or displayed rather than held or played. This is a shared coarse semantic state, not a claim of identical physical instruments or proof that every remaining difference is spurious.

coverage_summary.scope: 10 photo-to-cartoon proposals from 20 distinct source-training images: six acoustic and four electric pairs. One object class and one domain-pair type out of the 42 PACS class/domain-pair types; not PACS-wide coverage.
coverage_summary.background: Photos span plain fields, grass, bench and foliage, paneled doors and a decorated wall. Most candidates have white graphic fields. The contrasts are directionally imbalanced.
coverage_summary.palette: Natural wood, sunburst, blue and green photos versus brown, orange, red, gray-beige and blue candidates. Some palettes are similar; color change is not universal.
coverage_summary.lighting: Outdoor cast and dappled shadows, product-like reflections and flatter illustrated shading are present. Illumination has not been isolated experimentally.
coverage_summary.texture: Wood grain, grass, photographic surface detail, flat fills, outlines and stock-image watermarks. Watermarks are a possible nuisance and shortcut, not a desired semantic property.
coverage_summary.viewpoint: Mostly frontal or modestly oblique. Little rear, side-on or strongly occluded viewing; much visible change is rotation rather than 3-D viewpoint.
coverage_summary.crop: Whole-object presentation is retained with varying margin and scale. This group does not cover whole-to-detail changes; several objects are tightly framed.
coverage_summary.composition: Upright, rightward and diagonal instruments; one target guitar per image. A bench, flowers, notation, amplifier or cable adds scene content in some pairs.
coverage_summary.context: Grass, bench, interior walls, musical notation, amplifier and cable may carry meaning beyond background. Context is recorded as a potential semantic factor, not automatically counted as spurious.
coverage_summary.redundancy: No repeated image, duplicate source bytes or duplicate decoded pixels. Repeated displayed-state silhouettes and white candidate backgrounds remain; no exhaustive perceptual near-duplicate certification is claimed.
coverage_summary.missing_variation: No other object class, held or played state, multi-guitar scene, art-painting domain or sketch domain. Sketch remains held out. No image was selected from validation or test.
coverage_summary.audit_selection: Actual numerical roles are assigned after the group is fixed: medoid minimizes mean cosine distance between pair centers; boundary is farthest from that medoid; outlier maximizes nearest-neighbor distance; a seeded draw selects a random pair; minimum uncalibrated confidence selects the remaining role. Roles may overlap and do not establish validity.
coverage_summary.confidence: Coordinator scores range from 0.85 to 0.92 and are not calibrated. Fine construction, crop and context concerns remain for human judgment.

reasons_group_may_fail: Class, count and displayed state may be too coarse for semantic equivalence: body construction, cutaway shape, hardware, props or notation may change meaning.
The source metadata can disagree with visual appearance; one candidate is highly realistic despite the cartoon label. Metadata is not proof of semantic agreement or style contrast.
Descriptions at 227x227 cannot reliably resolve strings, tiny extra depictions or fine hardware. A second model check reduces neither uncertainty nor human workload to zero.
Coverage is deliberately narrow, with many plain white candidates and similar displayed-object shapes. Individual acceptance would not demonstrate broad group coverage.
Feedback exposure, hand-selected semantic grouping and a single small calibration batch prevent claims about fixed/adaptive effects or downstream GRIT robustness.
proposal_method: Independent image-only descriptions of a seeded 40-photo/40-cartoon training sample; coordinator metadata-visible matching; joint native-pixel check; independent second model check; retained shortlist revisions. Existing image features select audit highlights only, not pair matches.

pairs.semantic_rationale: Each image shows one acoustic guitar without a player: a waisted body, round sound hole, attached fretted neck and tuning head. Both show the instrument as a whole, with the neck directed toward the right.
pairs.spurious_rationale: The pale wooden photograph has visible grain, a handwritten marking, depth and soft shadow. The drawing uses a yellow flat fill, heavy black edges and a plain white field. Tilt and apparent depth differ.
pairs.uncertainty: Body outline, pickguard shape and the handwritten marking differ. Exact model and string count are unresolved; these are not claims of identical physical instruments. The photo's tuning head is tightly framed at the right.
pairs.confidence_meaning: Uncalibrated coordinator estimate under the coarse rubric; not a probability of human acceptance.

joint_pixel_check.limitations: Body outline, pickguard shape and the handwritten marking differ. Exact model and string count are unresolved; these are not claims of identical physical instruments. The photo's tuning head is tightly framed at the right.

pairs.semantic_rationale: Both show one acoustic guitar alone, with its complete body, sound hole, neck and headstock visible. Neither is held or played. The upright versus diagonal presentation preserves the displayed-object state.
pairs.spurious_rationale: The photo presents strongly striped wood against near black; the illustration presents more uniform brown shading on white. Surface grain, lighting cues, background and rotation change visibly.
pairs.uncertainty: The body silhouette and detailed bridge and headstock construction differ. A guitar's exact construction is not a locked match criterion, but could matter to the human reviewer.
pairs.confidence_meaning: Uncalibrated coordinator estimate under the coarse rubric; not a probability of human acceptance.

pairs.semantic_rationale: Both contain one whole acoustic guitar displayed without a person. The dark guitar-shaped outline behind the photographed neck is a shadow; the symbols beside the illustrated guitar are musical notation, not additional instruments.
pairs.spurious_rationale: Wooden boards, flowers, foliage and a cast shadow in the photo become a white field with drawn notation. Fine photographic grain and directional lighting become smoother illustrated surfaces.
pairs.uncertainty: The musical notes could suggest music or performance conceptually, although no person is playing the drawn guitar. The outdoor setting may carry contextual meaning; it is recorded separately rather than assumed harmless.
pairs.confidence_meaning: Uncalibrated coordinator estimate under the coarse rubric; not a probability of human acceptance.
